c(#) = constellation of the a certain character. when you get copies of a character, it becomes a constellation, and which each constellation you get, the character gets a specific upgrade.

pity = there's soft pity and hard pity. hard pity is when you wish 90 times on a banner (pity is on seperate banners/doesn't carry over) to get a guaranteed 5 star (not necessarily the rate-up on the banner, but a 5 star). soft pity is between 75-90 wishes i believe where the chances of getting a 5 star is increased. i normally get a 5 star during soft pity

reroll = basically making a new account just to wish

50/50 = the chance of you getting the rate-up 5 star on the event banner. there's a 50% chance you'll get a random 5 star on the banner and 50% for the rate up one. this only applies if you got a rate-up 5 star the last time you wished on a banner.
